text:
My chest was growing cold, helpless,

but my steps were light.

I put on my right hand

the glove from my left hand.


It seemed to me there were many steps,

although I knew there were only three!

An autumn murmur among the maples

asked me: "Die with me!


Listen: a painful,

fickle and wicked fate has deceived me!"

I answered it: "My dear:

me too. I will die with you!"


This is the song of the last meeting.

I cast a glance at the gloomy house.

Only in the bedroom did the candles burn

with an indifferent and withered flame.

translation.title: The Song of the Last Meeting
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the glove mistake, autumn murmur, and indifferent candlelight of the last meeting.
